title: Nasdaq’s @Nasdaq recent push on equity tokenization matters not because it creates a new “stock coin
content:
Nasdaq’s @Nasdaq recent push on equity tokenization matters not because it creates a new “stock coin,” but as it brings tokenized equities into the existing U.S. securities framework.

As highlighted by Eddie Xin, Head of Research at OSL Research, the real shift is not crypto wrapping stocks — it is regulated market infrastructure evolving toward tokenized form.

📌 A tokenized security is still a security.
📌 And the next phase may go far beyond trading alone, into corporate actions, proxy voting, and shareholder engagement.

This is not just a crypto product story.
It is a capital markets infrastructure story. 🏛️

content:

content: India’s Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) arrested Ayush Varshney, co-founder and CTO of Darwin Labs, at Mumbai airport for his role in the $790 million (₹6,606 crore) GainBitcoin fraud.
